criteria: Each attempt tests one distinct falsifiable control-plane hypothesis.
Every claimed defect has an executable reproduction against the immutable controller source.
Every non-defect conclusion records the exercised boundary and observed evidence.
The harness runs from a clean clone with Python standard-library dependencies only.
No test mutates PO-01, PR #8, protected state, or a path outside this run's owned subtree.
Artifacts have a complete manifest with SHA-256 and byte counts.
Provider completion remains separate from durable Obzio completion.
The producer reports READY_TO_COMMIT only; a different process must ingest and accept or reject.
